summary: Studio City International Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K to announce the release date of its first-quarter 2026 unaudited financial results. This is a routine earnings calendar announcement, not a special situation. There are no terms, recommendation, or deal mechanics involved. The filing is a standard disclosure of when earnings will be published, and contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change event. As a result, this filing does not meet the criteria for any special-situations category.
